Precision Machined OEM Parts

CNC Machining & VMC Workshop

Operating vertical machining centers and high-speed CNC lathes to supply finished, decarb-free components to international bearing brands.

Finishing Operations

High Precision Machining

Vimal Forge LLP provides full "billet-to-finish" components. Our machining workshop is equipped with high-speed turning centers and 3-axis VMC mills, allowing us to supply finish-turned bearing races and slot-milled gears directly to OEM assembly lines.

Machining Capacity Summary:

Turning Diameter LimitsUp to 300 mm (on CNC lathes)
Machining TolerancesWithin +/- 10 microns (+/-0.01 mm)
Die Sinking / MillingHaas 3-axis Vertical Machining Centers
Tolerances checkDigital air-gauging and verniers
Grinding & Metrology

Super-Finish Seating Grinding

For high-speed automotive and railway bearings, rough turned faces are not enough. We operate cylindrical grinding lines that polish bearing race tracks to sub-micron surface finishes. Every component is audited using electronic air gauging to verify diameter roundness limits, preventing noise and friction anomalies in final assemblies.

Roundness limits Within 5 microns
Laser Verification Traceable laser markings
